dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, could you help me with an email? I want to make a complaint to a travel company.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, kʊd juː ˈhɛlp miː wɪð ən ˈiːmeɪl? aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmeɪk ə kəmˈpleɪnt tə ə ˈtrævəl ˈkʌmpəni.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. Is it a formal email or an informal one?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ɪz ɪt ə ˈfɔːrməl ˈiːmeɪl ɔːr ən ɪnˈfɔːrməl ˈwʌn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Formal, I think. I don't know the name of the person who will read it.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɔːrməl, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ðə ˈneɪm əv ðə ˈpɜːrsən huː wɪl ˈriːd ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then start with "Dear Sir or Madam."
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈstɑːrt wɪð ˈdɪr ˈsɜːr ɔːr ˈmædəm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. In an informal email, I'd write, "Can you give me my money back?"
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ɪn ən ɪnˈfɔːrməl ˈiːmeɪl, aɪd ˈraɪt, kən juː ˈɡɪv miː maɪ ˈmʌni ˈbæk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's too direct for a formal email. Write, "I would be grateful if you could give me a refund."
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtuː dəˈrɛkt fər ə ˈfɔːrməl ˈiːmeɪl. ˈraɪt, aɪ wʊd bi ˈɡreɪtfəl ɪf juː kʊd ˈɡɪv miː ə ˈriːfʌnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "I would be grateful if you could…" That sounds very polite.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʊd bi ˈɡreɪtfəl ɪf juː kʊd… ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈvɛri pəˈlaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It is. You can also write, "I would appreciate it if you could reply soon."
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪz. juː kən ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈraɪt, aɪ wʊd əˈpriːʃieɪt ɪt ɪf juː kʊd rɪˈplaɪ ˈsuːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is a complaint the same as an inquiry?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ə kəmˈpleɪnt ðə ˈseɪm əz ən ˈɪnkwəri?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No. An inquiry is a question, for example, about prices. A complaint says that something is wrong.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ən ˈɪnkwəri ɪz ə ˈkwɛstʃən, fər ɪɡˈzæmpəl, əˈbaʊt ˈpraɪsɪz. ə kəmˈpleɪnt ˈsɛz ðæt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ˈrɔːŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So my email is a complaint, with a request at the end.
dialogue.reading: soʊ maɪ ˈiːmeɪl ɪz ə kəmˈpleɪnt, wɪð ə rɪˈkwɛst ət ði ˈɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. And never start a formal email with "Hi"!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ənd ˈnɛvər ˈstɑːrt ə ˈfɔːrməl ˈiːmeɪl wɪð ˈhaɪ!
